mode: host review with OCR file selection and rule resolution
scope: all existing unstaged/untracked changes plus affected ownership, measurement, input and sampler chains

findings.finding: geometryDidChange ignored reduced-motion preference during page/structure changes
findings.fix: apply same endpoint policy as retarget; added reducedMotionAlsoAppliesPageAndStructureEndpoints

findings.finding: closing while awaiting first geometry left transparent capacity window ordered in
findings.fix: orderOut and reclaim content on awaiting-geometry dismissal

findings.finding: awaiting-geometry hide left transparent bootstrap window visible
drag latch survived hidden interval when mouse-up monitor was removed
findings.fix: reset drag state with monitor cancellation

findings.finding: legacy Autotest archive sequence ran concurrently with benchmark, confounding attribution
findings.fix: make legacy sequence and explicit benchmark mutually exclusive

findings.finding: offscreen surface test used a lazy render-tree traversal and fixed delay that failed in full-suite execution
findings.fix: drive actual surface, inspect owner registry, verify window membership, serialize AppKit fixtures and wait for real measurements

findings.finding: comments described main-thread probe intervals as dropped display frames and measurement window omitted native tail
findings.fix: label scheduling intervals accurately; allow common measurement window for baseline and candidate

findings.finding: Autotest startup opener and switch timer close the first panel; pinned benchmark also starts a menu host
findings.fix: collector uses non-toggling 0:0 flag; menu opener excludes the explicitly selected pinned host

findings.finding: deadline recheck stopped after two deferrals and statistics were delayed together with UI publication
findings.fix: keyed latest-only PanelPublicationGate with generation cancellation; advance sampling cache and statistics immediately, defer only UI publication; five deterministic tests

findings.finding: hidden menu host ran the full benchmark alongside explicitly selected pinned host, invalidating cost and visibility attribution
findings.fix: selected-host guard; repeated both pinned paths with one scope and all 50 operations

findings.finding: unbounded probe subprocess and unchecked stress exit could produce an inaccurate finite-load receipt
findings.fix: bounded probe and metadata subprocesses; stress exit validation; raw stress results independently verified

findings.finding: fixed footer requires viewport reservation and hit routing based on presentation coordinates; shared module geometry offsets must not move chrome
findings.fix: footer outside scroll; reserved native and SwiftUI viewport space; presentation hit routing; footer excluded from module offsets; two geometry/trajectory regressions

findings.finding: explicit overlapping-QA exclusion was documented but not applied by resource summary script
findings.fix: apply analysis-exclusions.json to resource_comparison; preserve raw receipts and exclusion reason

coverage.manual_extra: tests and documents reviewed; reference binary/archive files verified by SHA and rebuild, not treated as editable production code
